👋🏻 Welcome to 3 minutes of my brain I guess 😂 from cleaning the bath to filling mini chicken tables 😂 But I hope you’re all having a great start to the week 🩷 and of course , Happy August!! Xx

items.transcript: Hello everyone, how are we? Three weeks into the school summer holidays. It's been interesting guys. Three young boys. I think I've lost the plot. But today I have a few hours to myself. So I'm going to go around each room in the house and have a little potter. See what I want to get done. A little dust about. Do you know what I mean? I want that coke in a wine glass. I'm ready. Can we just talk about the basket? I've got the watch. Yeah, I'm back. Stop it. One. Two. I'm so hot. Jamie's pants. Perfect. Now I've got this bed in. Oh my dog. What's that? How do you open this? Oh happy day. 10 out of 10. Excuse me, I need to rock the floors. Oh no gooselings. I need to clean the floors. Oh my God. Mission hit. I bought some little tables for my chickens. Honey no lie. Oh at least the actual toilet roll made it out of the toilet, but just made it to the kitchen worktop. Happy days. I don't know why I bought these chicken tables. Sweet gem lettuce. All on the cob. Some blueberry. Raspberries. Strawberries. I'm a mum of three boys, so my chicken gum are girls, okay? Just leave me to it. Hey girls. Mama's got you a new table. Come on over. Get out. Enjoy. Off of you fluffies. And that's me over and out everyone. Enjoy your feast girls. All the best.

items.caption:
🙊 New product alert ‼️ Who has one? Now this is a bit of me 😆 I’m a HUGE Febreze fan anyway so when I heard of the brand NEW Febreze Bin Freshener I was all over it (because the reality is no matter who you are in the world, no one wants a bad bin smell hitting them in the face 😂). So this right here is a new household essential for me! And I’ve finally collected all three scents 😂 woohoo 🎉 

#ADpartner #Febreze @joyofclean
items.transcript: Hello everyone, if you have somehow landed on this reel right now, we have something in common. Bins! That's right, bins, but have you seen the new Febreze bin freshener? And one thing I cannot stand is opening up a bin and being hit in the face with a bad bin smell. But we don't have to worry about that anymore, because Febreze has staged a national intervention, or should we say, bin-tervention. I will never say that again. Now, as most of you will probably know, I'm a huge Febreze fan, so for me, when I saw the new Febreze bin freshener, I was on it. And here she is, a brand new Febreze product designed to stick in your bin, to fight bin odours and release a fresh scent for up to 45 days. So which one are you going to choose? Citrus Fresh, Cotton Fresh or Outdoor Fresh, it's up to you. And you can even get your little refills. But these ones, they're mine. And yes, I've stocked up, so next time you're in store, check out the air care aisle. So from me and my fresh bin, all the best everyone.
